subject: Mathematics

source.topic: Numbers, operations and relationships: Number symbols and number names
source.subtopic: Recognise, identify and read number symbols 1-100

show.line: All the way to one hundred! Ninety nine, then one hundred. A one and two zeros. Let's read big numbers.

rounds.prompt: Count on. Ninety seven, ninety eight, ninety nine, and then?
Which number comes just before one hundred?
Tap the number fifty seven on the chart.

hints: The first digit is the tens. Eight means eighty.
One hundred is special. One, zero, zero.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will read this number.
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! Nine tens first. Ninety five.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's read it together. Nine tens is ninety. Ninety five!

parent_line: Can read number symbols up to 100.
